module: Shell command display and literal credential capture

findings.scenario: Adjacent quoted segments, escaped quotes/spaces and incomplete quoted values expose a credential suffix in local sandbox logs and persistent shell job metadata. Actual previewCommand and ShellJobSubmitRequest.MaskedCommand fixtures fail before the fix.
The same regular expression truncates shell literal values before they are passed to successful-skill credential capture. Quoted argument text can also overwrite a real assignment with a false value.

fix: Read complete shell words without evaluating commands. Mask assignment values and conservatively hide quoted script words/opaque expressions; capture only static prefix/export values, skipping argument text, dynamic expansion, comments and here-doc input. Mask before whitespace normalization.

validation.note: Shared package verification by concurrent SQL investigator after the final source branch was applied.

validation.result: PASS as part of combined invocation
Independent read-only investigator confirmed seven extra boundary regressions now pass. Fixed literals also compared with a local bash builtin printf using fixed fixture strings only.

review_followup: Added full-command word context after independent review caught quoted note capture, mid-word process substitution, carriage-return word content and colon tilde expansion.
Precommit review found and corrected quoted-script masking/comment-context regressions, then added legacy arithmetic $[ opaque handling.

One combined whole-package run observed concurrent SQL investigator before tests for TABLESAMPLE (and its initial error-string harness mismatch). Those failures are unrelated to this change; corrected SQL package run and final shell-focused races pass.
limits: This is a conservative literal extractor, not a shell interpreter: no substitution or runtime environment expansion is executed. Complex scripts may be omitted from displayed command metadata and are not inferred as reusable credentials.
No actual user commands, secrets or live shell jobs executed. A final consolidated whole-backend gate remains pending other active groups.
